For every natural n, listExtension(actualLicence kap B N)[n] = smoothNatural kap B N n by the current definitions. This is full integer equality, including proper powers; no prime-only agreement substitutes for the licence ambient profile.

The original chi is antitone; its dyadic bumps are nonnegative and the complete partition sums to one on 1 <= n <= cap. Every literal rough indicator is in [0,1], and n=0 is handled separately. Consequently the aggregated real weight lies in [0,1], without a chart-count or logarithmic amplitude factor.

For N >= 2 and a nonzero weight times labelled von Mangoldt factor, the existing profile_zero_below implies n > N^(1-kap); Fin(2*N+1) gives product <= 2*N. These are exactly the effective lower-coordinate and upper-product conditions passed to P3.

The one-letter properChartWords carrier is exactly natural proper prime powers in Icc 1 cap. It equals the image of the proper-labelled Fin 1 carrier under the original injective sourceWord map. The finite sum enumerates n once, rather than prime/exponent representations, and introduces no factorial or occurrence multiplicity.

lambdaOverLog and vonMangoldtOverLog agree also at 0 and 1 with total real division. The residual coefficient contains exactly one Lambda/log factor; it is not hidden in atlasWeight or multiplied twice.

The finite word kernel is identified with the same Q, rho, N and complete-product finiteProductKernel. finiteProductSignedError_fibres is applied with the complete Icc support. The count coefficient and exact coprime mean stay coupled to the same weight.

The equality identifies the positive properPowerReserve sum with the corresponding positive labelled residual. The original AllGroup formula subtracts that reserve; the consumer does not reverse this sign or replace the signed sum by a sum of chartwise norms.

The only analytic proper-power estimate is the existing ProperPowerChartSum.eventually_labelledProperPowerResidual_logAccuracy. The consumer constructs a bounded integer weight for that theorem; it does not claim the rough aggregate is a new smooth PP licence or reconstruct the arithmetic estimate.

For fixed kap < 1, A and positive eps, the eventual N threshold is chosen before B, the pre-HB rank K, kap0, Q and real rho. The fixed P3 parameter K=1 is distinct from the later arbitrary pre-HB rank K. The public strict modulus cutoff implies the supplier non-strict cutoff.

The second estimate uses A=2 and eps=tol*twinPrimeConstant, followed by the existing singularNormalization_lower. It bounds the norm of the original signed proper-power reserve sum by any positive share of the actual singular normalization.

conditions: eps > 0 (or tol > 0 for the normalization terminal)
for q in Q: 0 < q and (q : Real) < (N : Real)^(599/1000)

terminals.statement:
theorem original_singleton_properPowerReserve_sum_eq_labelledResidual
    (kap kap0 : ℝ) (B K N : ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ js ∈ chartBank (2 * N) 1,
      properPowerReserve (actualLicence kap B N) K (2 * N) N kap0 Q rho js) =
      finiteProductSignedError (Icc 1 (2 * N)) Q N rho
        (labelledProperPowerResidual 1 (2 * N) (atlasWeight kap kap0 B K N))
terminals.contract: Exact identity for the complete original singleton chart sum, with arbitrary complex rho and the same Q, N, complete-product residue kernel and exact coprime mean.

terminals.statement:
theorem eventually_original_singleton_atlas_properPower_logAccuracy
    (kap : ℝ) (hkap : kap < 1) (A eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (B K : ℕ) (kap0 : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 0 < q ∧ (q : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ (599 / 1000 : ℝ)) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |rho q| ≤ 1) →
      ‖∑ js ∈ chartBank (2 * N) 1,
        properPowerReserve (actualLicence kap B N) K (2 * N) N kap0 Q
          (fun q => (rho q : ℂ)) js‖ ≤
        eps * (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ A
terminals.contract: For fixed kap < 1, real A and eps > 0, the eventual threshold precedes all choices of B, K, kap0, Q and real rho. Positive moduli satisfy q < N^(599/1000), and abs(rho q) <= 1. The norm of the signed original reserve sum is at most eps*N/(log N)^A.

terminals.statement:
theorem eventually_original_singleton_atlas_properPower_singularNormalization
    (kap : ℝ) (hkap : kap < 1) (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (B K : ℕ) (kap0 : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 0 < q ∧ (q : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) ^ (599 / 1000 : ℝ)) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |rho q| ≤ 1) →
      ‖∑ js ∈ chartBank (2 * N) 1,
        properPowerReserve (actualLicence kap B N) K (2 * N) N kap0 Q
          (fun q => (rho q : ℂ)) js‖ ≤
        tol * singularNormalization N
terminals.contract: For fixed kap < 1 and tol > 0, the same uniform eventual choices and Q/rho hypotheses bound the norm of the signed original reserve sum by tol*singularNormalization N.
